::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IIT Delhi-incubated fabless startup (co-founder Dr Mukul Sarkar) and an inaugural winner of the Ministry of Defence's iDEX programme. Has raised over ₹300 crore in VC funding (including DLI support) and taped out test chips in 2025. Partnered with General Atomics-Aeronautical Systems since 2021 on co-designed defence electronics.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Indigenous SoC solutions for critical applications including surveillance and CCTV cameras.
